entries.title: Psalms 35:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Plead [my cause], O LORD, with those who strive with me; Fight against those who fight against me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:2
segments: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.

entries.title: Psalms 35:3
segments: Also draw out the spear, And stop those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I [am] your salvation."

entries.title: Psalms 35:4
segments: Let those be put to shame and brought to dishonor Who seek after my life; Let those be turned back and brought to confusion Who plot my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 35:5
segments: Let them be like chaff before the wind, And let the angel of the LORD chase [them].

entries.title: Psalms 35:6
segments: Let their way be dark and slippery, And let the angel of the LORD pursue them.

entries.title: Psalms 35:7
segments: For without cause they have hidden their net for me [in] a pit, [Which] they have dug without cause for my life.

entries.title: Psalms 35:8
segments: Let destruction come upon him unexpectedly, And let his net that he has hidden catch himself; Into that very destruction let him fall.

entries.title: Psalms 35:9
segments: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 35:10
segments: All my bones shall say, "LORD, who [is] like You, Delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him, Yes, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?"

entries.title: Psalms 35:11
segments: ¶Fierce witnesses rise up; They ask me [things] that I do not know.

entries.title: Psalms 35:12
segments: They reward me evil for good, [To] the sorrow of my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 35:13
segments: But as for me, when they were sick, My clothing [was] sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting; And my prayer would return to my own heart.

entries.title: Psalms 35:14
segments: I paced about as though [he were] my friend [or] brother; I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns [for his] mother.

entries.title: Psalms 35:15
segments: But in my adversity they rejoiced And gathered together; Attackers gathered against me, And I did not know [it]; They tore [at me] and did not cease;

entries.title: Psalms 35:16
segments: With ungodly mockers at feasts They gnashed at me with their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 35:17
segments: ¶Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue me from their destructions, My precious [life] from the lions.

entries.title: Psalms 35:18
segments: I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

entries.title: Psalms 35:19
segments: Let them not rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies; Nor let them wink with the eye who hate me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 35:20
segments: For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful matters Against [the] quiet ones in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 35:21
segments: They also opened their mouth wide against me, [And] said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen [it]."

entries.title: Psalms 35:22
segments: [This] You have seen, O LORD; Do not keep silence. O Lord, do not be far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:23
segments: Stir up Yourself, and awake to my vindication, To my cause, my God and my Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 35:24
segments: Vindicate me, O LORD my God, according to Your righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:25
segments: Let them not say in their hearts, "Ah, so we would have it!" Let them not say, "We have swallowed him up."

entries.title: Psalms 35:26
segments: Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor Who exalt themselves against me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:27
segments: Let them shout for joy and be glad, Who favor my righteous cause; And let them say continually, "Let the LORD be magnified, Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant."

entries.title: Psalms 35:28
segments: And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness [And] of Your praise all the day long.
